commits_info.message:
3.0.5 release (previous 3.0.4) + release notes updated by CI build 4175

[ci skip-release]

Fix issues in JavaDoc (#1760)

Fixes #1747: removed typo
Fixes #1513: Added missing tag to fix javadoc
Remove JDK env from Travis configuration (#1752)
Use OpenJDK instead of OracleJDK on Travis (#1751)

Clarify release notes to reduce confusion

Based on recent reports, it is still not clear that not every version is published to Maven Central. Therefore, I added a clarifying sentence. This also swaps the Bintray and Maven Central badge, to make sure people read the version from the Maven Central badge first.
